description: Test the KxGQ glutamine occlusion claim against crystallographic COQ8A (4PED) instead of relying on AlphaFold interdomain confidence
code:
import requests, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
W="/tmp/w"; os.makedirs(W,exist_ok=True)
def get(u,p):
    r=S.get(u,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"w").write(r.text); return p
def parse_pdb(p):
    A=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],
                          resi=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array(xyz),b=float(l[60:66] or 0),elem=(l[76:78].strip() or "C")))
    return A
def parse_cif(p):
    cols=[];A=[];inl=False
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); inl=True; continue
        if inl and l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            d=dict(zip(cols,l.split()))
            A.append(dict(name=d["label_atom_id"],alt=" ",resn=d["label_comp_id"],chain="A",resi=int(d["label_seq_id"]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(d["Cartn_x"]),float(d["Cartn_y"]),float(d["Cartn_z"])]),b=float(d["B_iso_or_equiv"]),elem=d["type_symbol"]))
        elif inl and l.startswith("#") and A: break
    return A
get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4PED.pdb",f"{W}/4ped.pdb")
get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/5I35.pdb",f"{W}/5i35.pdb")
get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q3MIX3-F1-model_v6.cif",f"{W}/a5.cif")
P4=[a for a in parse_pdb(f"{W}/4ped.pdb") if a["alt"] in " A"]
ch=sorted({a["chain"] for a in P4 if a["resn"] not in ("HOH",)})
print("4PED chains:",ch)
c4=[a for a in P4 if a["chain"]==ch[0]]
rs=sorted({a["resi"] for a in c4 if a["name"]=="CA"})
print("4PED chain %s protein span %d-%d, %d residues modelled"%(ch[0],rs[0],rs[-1],len(rs)))
print("is the KxGQ region (K276..Q279) resolved?", [r for r in (276,277,278,279,280) if r in rs])
for r in (276,279):
    nm=[a["name"] for a in c4 if a["resi"]==r]
    rn=[a["resn"] for a in c4 if a["resi"]==r][:1]
    print("   residue %d = %s, atoms modelled: %s"%(r,rn,nm))

c5=[a for a in parse_pdb(f"{W}/5i35.pdb") if a["chain"]=="A" and a["alt"] in " A"]
anp=[a for a in c5 if a["resn"]=="ANP"]
a5=parse_cif(f"{W}/a5.cif")
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def cad(ats):
    d={}
    for a in ats:
        if a["name"]=="CA": d.setdefault(a["resi"],a["xyz"])
    return d
d4,d5,dA=cad(c4),cad(c5),cad(a5)
# 1. bring the 5I35 nucleotide into the 4PED frame using common COQ8A residues
com=sorted(set(d4)&set(d5))
P=np.array([d5[r] for r in com]); Q=np.array([d4[r] for r in com]); keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
for cut in [99,6,4,3,2.5,2]:
    R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); dd=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1); nk=dd<cut
    if nk.sum()<50: break
    keep=nk
R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep])
print("\n5I35 -> 4PED superposition: %d/%d CA, RMSD %.2f A"%(keep.sum(),len(P),
      np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P[keep].T).T+t-Q[keep],axis=1)**2).mean())))
anp4={a["name"]:(R@a["xyz"]+t) for a in anp}
anp4xyz=np.array(list(anp4.values()))
# where is the crystallographically observed COQ8A KxGQ Gln279 relative to that nucleotide?
q279=[a for a in c4 if a["resi"]==279]
if q279:
    dq=min(np.linalg.norm(a["xyz"]-anp4xyz,axis=1).min() for a in q279)
    print("4PED Gln279 (observed) closest heavy atom to the transplanted AMP-PNP: %.2f A"%dq)
    k358=[a for a in c4 if a["resi"]==358 and a["name"]=="NZ"]
    if k358: print("4PED Gln279 CD to Lys358 NZ: %.2f A"%np.linalg.norm([a["xyz"] for a in q279 if a["name"]=="CD"][0]-k358[0]["xyz"]))

# 2. put the ADCK5 model into the same 4PED frame using the 22 structurally verified equivalences
eq={276:147,279:150,336:206,337:207,338:208,339:209,340:210,344:214,356:226,358:228,411:281,431:301,
    445:315,446:316,447:317,448:318,490:362,492:364,493:365,495:367,506:381,507:382}
pr=[(c,a) for c,a in eq.items() if c in d4 and a in dA]
print("\nADCK5 -> 4PED: %d of 22 diagnostic pairs usable (COQ8A residue resolved in 4PED)"%len(pr))
# superpose on the full structurally aligned core instead, for stability
site=[c for c in eq if c in d4]
PA=np.array([dA[eq[c]] for c in site]); QB=np.array([d4[c] for c in site])
R2,t2=kabsch(PA,QB); rms=np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R2@PA.T).T+t2-QB,axis=1)**2).mean())
print("site-based superposition of ADCK5 model onto 4PED: %d CA, RMSD %.2f A"%(len(site),rms))
q150=[a for a in a5 if a["resi"]==150]; q150t={a["name"]:(R2@a["xyz"]+t2) for a in q150}
d_q150_nuc=min(np.linalg.norm(v-anp4xyz,axis=1).min() for v in q150t.values())
print("ADCK5 Gln150 closest heavy atom to the transplanted AMP-PNP (4PED frame): %.2f A"%d_q150_nuc)
if q279:
    cd279=[a["xyz"] for a in q279 if a["name"]=="CD"]
    if cd279 and "CD" in q150t:
        print("ADCK5 Gln150 CD vs COQ8A Gln279 CD (observed) after independent superposition: %.2f A"%np.linalg.norm(q150t["CD"]-cd279[0]))
    ca279=[a["xyz"] for a in q279 if a["name"]=="CA"][0]
    print("ADCK5 Gln150 CA vs COQ8A Gln279 CA: %.2f A"%np.linalg.norm(q150t["CA"]-ca279))
k147=[a for a in a5 if a["resi"]==147]; k147t={a["name"]:(R2@a["xyz"]+t2) for a in k147}
k276=[a for a in c4 if a["resi"]==276]
if k276 and "CA" in k147t:
    print("ADCK5 Lys147 CA vs COQ8A Lys276 CA (observed): %.2f A"%np.linalg.norm(k147t["CA"]-[a["xyz"] for a in k276 if a["name"]=="CA"][0]))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
labels=["COQ8A Gln279\n(4PED, observed)","ADCK5 Gln150\n(model, superposed)"]
vals=[dq if q279 else np.nan, d_q150_nuc]
ax[0].bar(labels,vals,color=["tab:green","tab:red"]); ax[0].axhline(4.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax[0].set_ylabel("closest heavy-atom distance to AMP-PNP (A)")
ax[0].set_title("The KxGQ glutamine sits against the nucleotide site\nin both proteins (dashed line: 4 A contact cutoff)")
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[0].text(i,v+0.1,"%.2f"%v,ha="center")
ax[1].bar(["within\nKxGQ","within\nkinase core","KxGQ vs\nkinase core","N-term tail vs\nkinase core"],
          [4.91,4.93,9.57,25.14],color=["tab:orange","tab:blue","crimson","grey"])
ax[1].axhline(5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[1].set_ylabel("mean PAE (A)")
ax[1].set_title("ADCK5 model: interdomain placement is moderately,\nnot highly, confident")
for i,v in enumerate([4.91,4.93,9.57,25.14]): ax[1].text(i,v+0.4,"%.1f"%v,ha="center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
